lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At Horeb, Elijah entered a cave and spent the night. God asked him a question that reached beyond the storm outside.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: What are you doing here, Elijah?

lines.speaker: elijah
lines.text: I have been zealous for the LORD. Israel has broken your covenant, destroyed your altars, and killed your prophets. I am the only one left, and they are trying to kill me too.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Go out and stand on the mountain. The LORD is about to pass by.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A powerful wind tore at the mountain. But the LORD was not in the wind. Then came an earthquake—but the LORD was not in the earthquake.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then came fire. But the LORD was not in the fire. After the fire came a gentle whisper.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When Elijah heard it, he covered his face with his cloak and stood at the entrance of the cave.

choices.label: Listen for God in the quiet
choices.note: Elijah discovers that God's presence is not limited to spectacular signs. The quiet voice matters too.

choices.label: Expect another great sign
choices.note: Elijah has seen fire, rain, wind, and earthquakes. Now the story turns his attention from spectacle to listening.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Go back. Anoint Hazael king over Aram, Jehu king over Israel, and Elisha to succeed you as prophet. And remember: I have kept seven thousand in Israel who have not bowed to Baal.
